original_question: A water tank is filled with 120 liters of water. Celine used 90 liters of water from the tank to water her small garden. She was then able to collect rainwater that is twice as much as what was left. How many liters of water are in the tank now?
question_template: A water tank is filled with {num_digit_1, 120} liters of water. {name_female, Celine} used {num_digit_2, 90} liters of water from the tank to water her small garden. She was then able to collect rainwater that is {num_text_1, twice} as much as what was left. How many liters of water are in the tank now?
question_solution: answer = (num_digit_1 - num_digit_2) * (1 + f1)   # f1 is the numeric value of num_text_1
